summary: 1024 number game brings you cool math, brain teaser and mind puzzle fun!
description:
1024 Puzzle Numbers Game is an addictive number puzzle game based on simple addition and merging number puzzles. Set your victory target: 1024, 2048, 4096, or even higher numbers — it's your choice!

Enjoy this free super puzzle game filled with number games, cool math games, logic puzzles, brain teasers, and endless fun.

HOW TO PLAY:
Swipe (Up, Down, Left, Right) to move all tiles. After every swipe, a new tile of 2 or 4 appears in a random empty spot. When two tile puzzles with a same number touch, they merge into one. 2+2=4, 4+4=8, 8+8=16, 16+16=32, 32+32=64, 64+64=128, 128+129=256, .. 512 .. 1024 ..., when 2048 puzzle is created, you win! When there’s zero available spot and zero adjacent tiles with a same numeral, you lose.

- Five undos. Correct mistakes easily.
- Variety of boards. Classic (4x4), small (3x3), big (5x5), bigger (6x6), huge (8x8) boards!
- Endless mode. After winning at 1024 or 2048 tile, you can challenge 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536, 131072 ... to ENDLESS!
- Auto Save. Your game process is automatically saved
- Support for backing up and restoring game progress across devices. If you want to transfer your game progress from an old phone to a new phone, no problem!
- Beautiful UI & Smooth Animations: Enjoy a clean and simple interface.
- Leaderboards: Compete with players worldwide.
- Native implementation, best performance, low storage, small app
- Play 1024 game and 2248 puzzle game
- Continue the game after reaching 1024 or 2048.
- Numbers: 2024, 1023, 2047, 2084, 1048, 2408, 2049, 2480, 2028, 2025, 2046

The three multiply three ( 3 x 3 ) mode is hardest while the eight multiply eight ( 8 x 8 ) mode is easiest since they have fewest and most empty spots separately.

Slide screen, join the numbers, merge the puzzles, get to 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, … then win! This fun numbers app is for adult, teenagers, and kids. Everyone can experience cool math logic in this exciting puzzles game.

Now start training your brain and mind, and enjoy playing this free cool math, educational, and addicting mini 1024 puzzle numbers game! Challenge your best score and enjoy the ultimate number puzzle experience!
